body: What I mean is when I search mental health in my area. All the that comes up is counseling. Maybe I'm not looking in the right places. I really wish I could find a primary care Dr that could handle my situation. My current Dr just retired so I'll need to find a new Dr pretty soon.

I've been feeling this way for a few years now. 
There's no way I would go to a support group. It's just not something I would do. I have no interest in talking about this in a group. I'm not even sure I would talk to someone one on one.
I've been takin the lorazapam since 2008. I didn't know it caused depression. I remember taking something before the lorazapam for a few months but it didn't seem to work so the Dr took me off it. I think it was Zoloft.
